name: debugging-discipline
description: Systematic diagnosis for bugs that resist the ordinary red-test path. Builds a tight, red-capable feedback loop before any theorizing (flaky reruns, curl harnesses, diff/replay loops, bisection, perf measurement), minimizes the failure, then tests 3-5 ranked falsifiable hypotheses with stated predictions — a fix that works while its prediction fails is a symptom, not the cause. Composes with discipline-gates: seamed bugs get their red test from test-discipline's repro contract; this skill owns the no-seam loop constructions and the hypothesis epistemics. Trivial bugs fast-path out silently.
